name: Binance spot BTCUSDT aggregate trades
description: Normalized `aggTrade` messages from the Binance spot `btcusdt@aggTrade` stream on the market-data-only host wss://data-stream.binance.vision/stream. This definition promotes the existing refusal-gated capture adapter to an adopted source and describes exactly what that adapter already emits; it adds no adapter behaviour. `agg_trade_id` is a monotonic per-symbol counter and is the ordering key: an equal id is a duplicate and a lower id is out of order, both dropped; an id jump raises a gap recovery notice while still emitting the in-hand trade, because a Binance WebSocket reconnect does not backfill and REST backfill is outside this slice. The aggregate-trade cursor persists across reconnects so a hole spanning a reconnect is caught on the first post-reconnect trade. `buyer_is_maker` is the venue `m` flag preserved verbatim and `aggressor_side` is its inverse. Refusal-gated: Binance redistribution requires written consent (see RIGHTS-LEDGER.md). Rights-gated: the Binance row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md defers commercial redistribution, and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists binance (R7).
